title: Remove PDF export option and fix Save project action

requirements.text: Remove the PDF export option from the Export tab. The CSV export option should remain. The PDF-related UI elements (button, description, limit indicator) must be fully removed from ExportTab.tsx. The usePdfExport hook and any print-related CSS in index.css may be left in place but must no longer be surfaced in the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: The Export tab no longer shows a PDF download button or any PDF-related UI.
CSV export option remains visible and functional.
No console errors related to the removed PDF elements.

requirements.text: Fix the 'Save' project action in DashboardHeader. Investigate the saveProject mutation flow in ProjectContext.tsx and useQueries.ts (the backend save call), identify why saving fails, and correct it so that clicking Save successfully persists the current project to the backend and shows a success toast.

quotes: The 'Save' models action is failing, please correct it.

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the Save button in DashboardHeader successfully calls the backend save endpoint without errors.
A success toast is displayed after a successful save.
An error toast is displayed if the save fails, with a meaningful message.
The saved project can be subsequently loaded via the Load modal.

constraints: Do not remove or alter the CSV export functionality.
Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Redesigning the Export tab layout beyond removing PDF elements.
Changes to chart PNG export functionality.
Changes to subscription or payment flows.
